summary: Closure is OPEN. The review process holds up: two independent reports, full coverage of the 40 required captures plus the supplementary, real-app and re-captured shots, every cited screenshot exists, and every blocking item is routed. But 6 of the 8 merged majors have not been repaired, re-captured or re-reviewed. The central AC-7 requirement, that both action buttons are fully visible on the expanded card at both widths, is not met at 900×700 in the harness or at either width in the real app. After the image-session-repair fixes (U-01, U-02, U-04, and U-06 or its criteria decision) and the image-session-verify captures (U-03, U-05), both reviewers must re-review the affected states before this audit can close.
